stories.line: Zoning updates to match new state law on variances, grandfathering: vote (Article 11).
stories.headline: Hubbardston Town Meeting takes up zoning changes
stories.dek: Hubbardston's Town Meeting is Tuesday, Oct 27. The warrant (the list of what voters will decide) lists an article on zoning changes.
stories.quote: …TO THE ZONING ACT, G.L. c. 40A (Two-thirds vote required) To see if the Town will vote to amend the Hubbardston Zoning Bylaws Sections 2.32, 4.2, 4.9, 4.10, 4.11, 4.12, 10.1, 10.4, and 17.9…

brief.what: Article 11 rewrites parts of the zoning bylaw to match recent changes to the state Zoning Act: variances would turn on "practical difficulty" instead of "substantial hardship", some additions to older nonconforming homes would be allowed without a special permit, a nonconforming use would be lost after four years of abandonment instead of two, and a permit's protection would run twenty-four months instead of six.
brief.next: Two-thirds vote required (the warrant says so), then Attorney General review.
brief.history: The Planning Board held a public hearing Sep 17 on revising the zoning bylaw for consistency with the state budget bill's changes on entitlements, non-conformities and variances.
